title: Pesticide label and pre-harvest safety
category: Food growing · Pest and disease control
summary: Treat the legal label as the controlling instruction for any crop-protection product.
steps: Confirm the exact crop and target pest are listed; a product for another crop is not automatically suitable.
Read dose, mixing, application limits, protective equipment, re-entry and environmental restrictions before opening.
Measure with dedicated labelled equipment and prevent drift to people, animals, water and neighbouring crops.
Record date, product, rate, treated area and the required pre-harvest interval.
Do not harvest or distribute produce until the full interval and all label requirements are satisfied.
